title: AI Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As an AI Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

6. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

description:

Top Skills' Details

1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations.

2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development).

3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery.

3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).

4.) Hands on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation’s leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience , strong full‑stack engineering skills , and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS , NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , event‑driven integrations, and data‑sync pipelines.
  • Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation , ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.

AWS Engineering & Architecture

  • Build serverless and microservices‑based applications using Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , RDS , EventBridge , SNS/SQS , and related AWS services.
  • Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.

Full‑Stack Development

  • Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.

Advanced Development & Data Workflows

  • Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).‑performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).
  • Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‑scale data migrations and cross‑platform synchronization.
  • Perform deep‑dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‑vs‑Buy recommendations.
  • Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority.
  • Expert level AWS development experience , especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‑level AWS development experience ‑driven architectures.
  • Strong full‑stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).
  • Proven track record developing REST APIs , microservices, and cloud‑native applications.
  • Hands‑on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs .
  • Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‑scale migration tooling.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly.
  • Strong analytical and root‑cause debugging skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with EventBridge , AppFlow , or enterprise iPaaS tools.
  • Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‑system enterprise architecture.

Enfermeiro(a) na Alemanha

Programa:

Como funciona?

• Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo). Você escolhe onde estudar — na escola da Sprache&Wissen (maior online de alemão da América Latina) ou em outra instituição validada. Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S&W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.


Quem é a Sprache&Wissen?

• A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.


Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

• Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico

• Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos

• Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão

• Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador


Requisitos:

• Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil

• Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)

• Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários

• Comprometimento com as etapas do programa

• Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)


Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível)

• Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico

• Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio

title: Psiquiatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Psiquiatra em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. VAGA PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA — ATENDIMENTO ONLINE

A Dr Psiq está em expansão e busca médicos(as) psiquiatras comprometidos(as), éticos(as) e responsáveis para atuação em telemedicina, realizando atendimentos psiquiátricos por vídeo em nossa plataforma digital.

Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados.

Principais atividades
  • Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo;
  • Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico;
  • Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados;
  • Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos;
  • Evolução em prontuário eletrônico;
  • Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos;
  • Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes.
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • CRM ativo e regular;
  • Formação em Psiquiatria através de:
  • Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou
  • Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida;
  • Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico;
  • Boa comunicação e postura ética;
  • Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento;
  • Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos.
Documentação obrigatória

O profissional deverá apresentar:

  • Currículo atualizado;
  • Documento de identificação profissional;
  • CRM ativo;
  • Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina;
  • Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM;
  • Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM;
  • Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria;
  • RQE (quando aplicável);
  • Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma.
Processo seletivo

Após análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição.

Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail:

Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do WhatsApp:

informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional.

Diferenciais
  • Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência;
  • Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência;
  • Formação complementar em psicoterapia;
  • Fluência em outros idiomas;
  • Disponibilidade para educação continuada.
Modelo de atuação
  • Atendimento 100% online;
  • Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica;
  • Flexibilidade de agenda;
  • Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas;
  • Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional.

A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico:

  • Mantenha disponibilidade regular no WhatsApp para comunicação com a equipe da clínica;
  • Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas;
  • Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável;
  • Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento.
O que esperamos do profissional

Mais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com:

  • Responsabilidade profissional;
  • Pontualidade e organização;
  • Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas;
  • Respeito aos pacientes;
  • Ética e humanização no atendimento;
  • Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

title: Enfermeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Enfermeiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga:

Enfermeiro(a) na Alemanha


Salário:

• +R$14.500,00 (+2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios.


Localidade:

• Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)


Programa:

• Enfermanha - Enfermagem na Alemanha, da Sprache&Wissen.


Como funciona?

• Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo). Você escolhe onde estudar — na escola da Sprache&Wissen (maior online de alemão da América Latina) ou em outra instituição validada. Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S&W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.


Quem é a Sprache&Wissen?

• A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.


Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

• Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico

• Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos

• Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão

• Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador


Requisitos:

• Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil

• Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)

• Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários

• Comprometimento com as etapas do programa

• Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)


Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível)

• Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico

• Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado


Sobre o período de estudos:

• Você estuda alemão do Brasil enquanto se prepara para a mudança

• Mentoria em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2

• Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual


Etapas do processo:

1. Inscrição e triagem inicial

2. Reunião com o time da S&W

3. Questionários e aprovação

4. Planejamento de estudos

5. Curso de alemão (até o nível B2)

6. Match com recrutador alemão

7. Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Psiquiatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Psiquiatra em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. VAGA PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA — ATENDIMENTO ONLINE

A Dr Psiq está em expansão e busca médicos(as) psiquiatras comprometidos(as), éticos(as) e responsáveis para atuação em telemedicina, realizando atendimentos psiquiátricos por vídeo em nossa plataforma digital.

Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados.

Principais atividades
  • Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo;
  • Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico;
  • Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados;
  • Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos;
  • Evolução em prontuário eletrônico;
  • Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos;
  • Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes.
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • CRM ativo e regular;
  • Formação em Psiquiatria através de:
  • Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou
  • Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida;
  • Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico;
  • Boa comunicação e postura ética;
  • Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento;
  • Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos.
Documentação obrigatória

O profissional deverá apresentar:

  • Currículo atualizado;
  • Documento de identificação profissional;
  • CRM ativo;
  • Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina;
  • Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM;
  • Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM;
  • Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria;
  • RQE (quando aplicável);
  • Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma.
Processo seletivo

Após análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição.

Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail:

Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do WhatsApp:

informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional.

Diferenciais
  • Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência;
  • Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência;
  • Formação complementar em psicoterapia;
  • Fluência em outros idiomas;
  • Disponibilidade para educação continuada.
Modelo de atuação
  • Atendimento 100% online;
  • Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica;
  • Flexibilidade de agenda;
  • Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas;
  • Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional.

A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico:

  • Mantenha disponibilidade regular no WhatsApp para comunicação com a equipe da clínica;
  • Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas;
  • Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável;
  • Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento.
O que esperamos do profissional

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.


Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You’ll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.


Key Qualifications

  • Node.js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.


Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?



About you:

This is a direct-hire, high-impact position designed for a support professional who views every interaction as an opportunity to build a relationship. As a Customer Support Specialist, you are the primary face and voice of Smarter Contact across our multiple support channels.


Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. You are not just closing tickets, you are solving complex SMS delivery issues, guiding customers through compliance requirements, and ensuring every interaction is handled with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.


As a frontline representative of the company, you are uniquely positioned to identify customer needs and opportunities to improve retention and account growth. You will help surface opportunities for plan upgrades and add-ons while serving as a first line of defence against churn by identifying customer friction early, escalating issues appropriately, and partnering closely with Success and Product teams to help customers stay successful and engaged.



What You’ll Own:

  • Provide high-quality assistance through real-time chat, emails and phone calls, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels.
  • Consistently maintain a CSAT score of over 85% while meeting targets for response times and resolution speed.
  • Achieve monthly revenue quotas by identifying and closing plan upgrades during customer interactions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chats, calls, and tasks within the CRM to ensure team-wide visibility.
  • Identify early warning signs like frustration or delivery issues during live chats and resolve them to protect account health.
  • Reinforce the Smarter Contact value proposition and competitive edge in every customer conversation.
  • Capture and relay frontline insights regarding bugs, UX friction, and feature requests to the Product and Leadership teams.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 8 AM - 8 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

﻿

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista (RQE) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)-  Banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco de talentos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. A atividade diária principal será receber artes prontas das agências dos EUA para executar ajustes (no InDesign) conforme comentários (em inglês) feitos no PDF. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica.

Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
  • Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso.
  • Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator;
  • Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos WorkFront);

title: BI Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para BI Operations Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Sr AI Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr AI Engineer - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer


PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO

A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop.

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

• Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

• Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

• Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

• Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

• Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

• AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.


Job Description


The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”

• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.

• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?



About you:

This is a direct-hire, high-impact position designed for a support professional who views every interaction as an opportunity to build a relationship. As a Customer Support Specialist, you are the primary face and voice of Smarter Contact across our multiple support channels.


Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. You are not just closing tickets, you are solving complex SMS delivery issues, guiding customers through compliance requirements, and ensuring every interaction is handled with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.


As a frontline representative of the company, you are uniquely positioned to identify customer needs and opportunities to improve retention and account growth. You will help surface opportunities for plan upgrades and add-ons while serving as a first line of defence against churn by identifying customer friction early, escalating issues appropriately, and partnering closely with Success and Product teams to help customers stay successful and engaged.



What You’ll Own:

  • Provide high-quality assistance through real-time chat, emails and phone calls, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels.
  • Consistently maintain a CSAT score of over 85% while meeting targets for response times and resolution speed.
  • Achieve monthly revenue quotas by identifying and closing plan upgrades during customer interactions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chats, calls, and tasks within the CRM to ensure team-wide visibility.
  • Identify early warning signs like frustration or delivery issues during live chats and resolve them to protect account health.
  • Reinforce the Smarter Contact value proposition and competitive edge in every customer conversation.
  • Capture and relay frontline insights regarding bugs, UX friction, and feature requests to the Product and Leadership teams.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 8 AM - 8 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

description:

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:


• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

• Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.

• Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.
